text:
maria: quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR updating the runtime config examples and the SDK snippet for `response_mode`. Need a reviewer and to confirm merge timing before tomorrow's docs deploy (09:00 PT).

kai: assigning myself as reviewer but quick note — the preview build shows a linkcheck error and one snippet that relies on a runtime default. :eyes:

maria: thanks! the doc currently says `response_mode` defaults to `buffered` if omitted. runtime folks — is that still true when `stream_heuristic` is enabled?

sam: putting in the short answer: runtime changed behavior last quarter. If `stream_heuristic=true` the server may switch the endpoint to stream even if `response_mode` omitted. That was to optimize latency for short chats.

maria: ah ok that's the mismatch. Docs should indicate the conditional default. I can update text but want runtime confirm so we don't accidentally ship wrong guidance.

yan: can we instead make the SDK snippet explicit? e.g. `response_mode: "buffered"` — that avoids ambiguity for callers.

kai: +1 to explicit snippet. But we still need to know if the hosted API will keep doing that fallback; the example for Private/Dedicated should be different.

lin: FYI the docs preview linkcheck fails on this PR:
```
Error: Broken link /docs/runtime/PrivateConfig#StreamHeuristic -> 404
```
I traced it to an anchor change in the runtime docs. If we fix anchors or point to the higher-level page it should pass.

maria: ok I'll update the snippet to set `response_mode: "buffered"` explicitly and change the link to the runtime overview. But I want a runtime + eng confirmation before merge. Can someone from runtime confirm by EOD?

sam: i'll ping runtime on-call and check config. @yan can you confirm whether Dedicated/Private still default to buffered regardless of `stream_heuristic`?

yan: Dedicated/Private (customer-managed) keep buffered by default; only Hosted uses the heuristic toggle in the control plane. So we should call that out.

maria: perfect — that resolves the behavior split. I'll make two snippets: one for Hosted with a note about `stream_heuristic` and one explicit example for Dedicated/Private.

kai: after docs edits, i'll run local linkcheck. If green, i'll approve. Schedule: if we can get the runtime confirmation + green linkcheck before 08:30 PT tomorrow, we can merge in the 08:45 docs window. Otherwise hold for next deploy.

lin: re: CI — github actions currently failed, posting job output:

github-actions: 

[linkcheck] broken links found:
 - /docs/runtime/PrivateConfig#StreamHeuristic -> 404
 - /api/private/config -> 404
job linkcheck FAILED in 2m 12s

maria: thanks, i'll update links and snippets now. I'll request a quick review from kai after.

sam: i'll follow up with runtime on-call and confirm Hosted behavior within the hour. Will post here. :thumbsup:

kai: sounds good. marking PR as WIP -> ready-for-review after my pass.

maria: status: pushed fixes (explicit `response_mode`, switched anchor to runtime overview). pinging CI retrigger.

github-actions: re-run triggered by maria. linkcheck passed.

kai: reviewing now. if nothing else pops up i'll approve and we can merge into the 08:45 window pending runtime final ack.

sam: runtime ack: Hosted will continue the heuristic fallback for short chats; we'll add a short RFC note to the runtime docs but behavior stands.

maria: thanks everyone — putting merge on the 08:45 docs window. leaving a short explainer in the PR about the Hosted/Dedicated difference.

kai: approved. :white_check_mark:

maria: merged during window. thanks all! :rocket:
